title: Content & Social Media Specialist
description:
Are you a creative, commercially minded content professional who knows how to make a B2 B brand stand out? Join Burgess & Hodgson and take ownership of content that brings expertise to life, builds our profile and delivers measurable results.

Content & Social Media Specialist

Canterbury Office-based
- Competitive salary, depending on experience
- Full-time, Monday to Friday, 9am-5.30pm

About Us

At Burgess & Hodgson, we want our online presence to reflect the quality of the firm behind it. Our small, ambitious marketing team works closely with partners and directors to share their expertise, tell client stories and create content that connects with our audience.

We're looking for a Content & Social Media Specialist who enjoys owning their work from start to finish, combining writing and design with strategy, scheduling and reporting.

About the Role

This is a varied, hands-on opportunity to shape how Burgess & Hodgson shows up online. You'll work across written, visual and video content, helping us maintain a consistent brand and turn marketing activity into meaningful outcomes.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Writing compelling, technically sound copy for social media, email, web and campaigns, turning partner expertise, client stories and market insights into engaging content while maintaining a consistent brand voice across all digital touchpoints.
- Planning, writing and delivering HubSpot email campaigns aligned with wider marketing activity, monitoring results and recommending improvements to engagement and conversion.
- Managing our social channels day to day, including LinkedIn and Instagram, owning the content calendar, scheduling posts, monitoring engagement, responding where appropriate and growing our visibility and relevance.
- Shooting and editing short-form video for social and digital channels, and creating graphics and visual assets using Adobe InDesign, Canva and other design tools, involving external suppliers for larger production projects where needed.
- Using HubSpot to track campaign activity, manage workflows and maintain accurate data, working with our Growth Operations Manager to build reports, analyse performance and turn findings into clear recommendations.
- Keeping our WordPress website fresh, accurate and on-brand, writing and optimising content to implement our external agency's SEO and GEO recommendations, understanding how search engines and AI tools surface information, and sharing analytics insights with the team and agency.
- Supporting digital campaigns, events and announcements, working closely with partners and directors to develop content that reflects their expertise and strengthens the firm's profile and reputation.
- Briefing and liaising with external SEO, design and production agencies to deliver work on time, while organising your workload and contributing reliably to a small team where everyone's output matters.

About You

You'll be a creative, self-directed content professional with commercial awareness and the confidence to take ideas through to delivery. You understand how content supports business outcomes and enjoy working collaboratively in a small, fast-moving team.

You'll bring:
- At least three years' experience in a content or social media role, owning the function end to end, ideally within B2 B or professional services.
- Exceptional copywriting skills and an understanding of how to write for a business audience.
- Confidence creating written, visual and video content.
- Experience using HubSpot, Adobe InDesign, WordPress and Google Analytics.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
- A collaborative approach and the ability to work independently.
- Availability to work in our Canterbury office Monday to Friday, 9am-5.30pm.

How to Apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Content & Social Media Specialist position based in Canterbury, click "apply" today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

No agencies please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Content Marketing Specialist, Social Media Manager, Content Marketing Executive, Digital Marketing Executive, Social Media Executive, Content Creator, Marketing Communications Executive, B2 B Copywriter, Email Marketing Executive, Digital Content Specialist.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
company: Diamond Search Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

Recruitment Agency: Diamond Search Recruitment
Location: Tunbridge Wells - Hybrid
Salary: £35 K plus great benefits!
Job Type: Full-time

About the Opportunity

Diamond Search Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting for a Digital Marketing Executive on behalf of a well-established professional services organisation. This is an excellent opportunity for a creative, digitally minded marketing professional to join a collaborative Business Development and Marketing team and play an important role in enhancing the organisation s digital presence.

Working closely with the Marketing and Communications Manager, you will support the delivery of digital marketing campaigns across the website, social media, email marketing, video content and online advertising. You will have the opportunity to combine creativity with analytical thinking, helping to build brand awareness, engage audiences, increase website traffic and generate new business opportunities.

This role would suit someone with digital marketing experience who enjoys creating engaging content, exploring new digital trends and using performance insights to improve campaign results.

Key Responsibilities

Website & SEO
- Manage and update website content, supporting website development and user experience improvements.
- Assist with campaign landing pages and digital content publishing.
- Work with external agencies to implement SEO recommendations.
- Monitor website performance, analyse results and report against key performance indicators.
- Support colleagues with website content management and promote best practice.

Social Media & Content Creation
- Manage and monitor social media channels to increase brand awareness and engagement.
- Develop and maintain a social media content calendar.
- Create, schedule and publish engaging, accurate and timely content across relevant platforms.
- Monitor performance and identify opportunities to improve reach and engagement.
- Provide guidance to colleagues on social media best practice and emerging trends.

Video Production & Editing
- Support the planning, filming and editing of video content for digital campaigns, social media, the website, email marketing and events.
- Produce engaging multimedia content, incorporating captions, graphics, music and brand elements.
- Adapt video content for different platforms and ensure accessibility standards are met.
- Maintain an organised library of digital assets and use performance insights to improve future content.

Email Marketing
- Create and deliver targeted email marketing campaigns in line with agreed marketing plans.
- Build and test email campaigns, checking copy, links, formatting and audience segmentation before launch.
- Analyse campaign performance and recommend improvements.
- Maintain and optimise email templates.
- Support colleagues with marketing technology, including ClickDimensions.

Digital Advertising & Campaign Performance
- Work with external agencies to support Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing) campaigns.
- Assist with paid social media campaign delivery and optimisation.
- Monitor enquiries generated through digital campaigns and help assess lead quality and outcomes.
- Identify opportunities to improve targeting, engagement and advertising performance.

Wider Marketing Support
- Help maintain consistent branding and visual identity across all digital channels.
- Collaborate with colleagues, internal stakeholders and external agencies.
- Share ideas and recommendations to improve digital marketing activity and overall performance.
- Support the wider Business Development and Marketing function as required.

About You

You will be a proactive and creative digital marketer with a strong eye for detail, excellent communication skills and a genuine interest in developing your digital marketing expertise.

Essential experience and skills:

At least two years experience in a digital marketing role.

Experience supporting campaigns across websites, email marketing, social media and online advertising.

Working knowledge of content management systems, ideally WordPress, alongside Google Analytics and SEO tools.

Experience using email marketing platforms and social media management tools.

Strong copywriting and digital content creation skills, including image and video editing.

Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva or similar tools.

Good analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and recommend practical improvements.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.

A collaborative approach, combined with the confidence to work independently and take initiative.

Desirable:

Experience within a professional services or B2 B environment.

Familiarity with CRM systems and marketing automation platforms, particularly ClickDimensions.

A marketing degree or professional marketing qualification, ideally with a digital marketing focus.

GCSEs or equivalent in English and Mathematics are required as a minimum. Graduate-level education is preferred but not essential.

Additional Requirements

The role may involve attending events and meetings in London and other regional locations.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to develop your digital marketing career within a collaborative professional environment, working across a varied mix of creative content, digital campaigns, website optimisation, email marketing and paid advertising.

You will be able to contribute ideas, develop your technical skills and see the impact of your work across a range of digital channels.

Apply Today

If you are a creative and commercially minded digital marketer looking for your next opportunity, Diamond Search Recruitment would love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV to be considered for this exciting Digital Marketing Executive opportunity.

Diamond Search Recruitment is managing this recruitment process on behalf of its client.

title: Senior SEO Manager
description:
Are you an experienced SEO professional who enjoys having real ownership of strategy, working directly with clients and seeing your recommendations turn into commercial results?

We're looking for a Senior SEO Manager to join a growing, close-knit digital team and take the lead on SEO strategy across a varied portfolio of established eCommerce, B2 B and professional services clients.

This is a hands-on senior role where you'll have the freedom to shape strategy, influence clients and work closely with developers, account managers and growth specialists to make things happen.

What you'll be doing

You'll take full ownership of your SEO accounts, from identifying opportunities and building strategic roadmaps through to implementation, reporting and client presentations.

Your role will include:
- Developing and leading SEO strategies aligned to clients' commercial objectives
- Managing senior client relationships and leading regular SEO meetings
- Identifying opportunities across technical, on-page and content SEO
- Carrying out keyword, competitor and search landscape research
- Working directly with developers to prioritise and implement technical improvements
- Analysing performance and delivering commercially focused reporting
- Advising on SEO for website builds, migrations and launches
- Supporting pitches and new business opportunities as the SEO specialist
- Working with Account Managers to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts
- Keeping ahead of changes in search, including AI search and emerging platforms

What we're looking for

You'll have at least five years' SEO experience, ideally in an agency or similar environment where you've managed multiple clients and taken ownership of both strategy and relationships.

You'll bring:
- Strong experience developing and leading SEO strategies
- Proven experience managing senior client relationships
- Excellent technical, on-page and content SEO knowledge
- Experience managing SEO for eCommerce websites
- Confidence presenting strategy, recommendations and results to clients
- Strong knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console and leading SEO tools
- A good understanding of website development and experience working with developers
- Experience with website migrations and new website launches
- Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how SEO drives leads, sales and revenue
- The confidence to challenge existing approaches and recommend a better way forward
- A genuine interest in AI search and the changing search landscape

Experience with Magento/Adobe Commerce, WordPress or App Store Optimisation would be an advantage.

Why join?

You'll be joining a small, collaborative team where your ideas genuinely matter. You'll work closely with senior leadership and have visibility across the wider business, rather than being another cog in a large agency machine.

You'll work with a diverse mix of ambitious start-ups and established eCommerce brands across different industries and technologies, meaning no two projects are the same.

There's also a strong focus on development, with access to training and regular collaboration with an international development team.

And when the team hits its monthly and annual targets, there are socials and trips away to celebrate together.
